snippet.title: Aliens Stole the World Cup Trophy?! Soccer Kid Collection - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Soccer Kid Collection officially launches on June 18, 2026, right in the middle of the World Cup season!

In 1983, the real World Cup trophy mysteriously vanished in Brazil. In 1993, Krisalis Software turned that wild concept into one of the most mechanically unique 16-bit platformers of its era: Soccer Kid.

Now, under the QUByte Classics lineup, this gem is arriving on modern consoles (Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox) and PC via Steam with full emulation preservation and pristine modern features! The collection includes the SNES and MS-DOS versions.

📅 Release Date: June 18, 2026
🎮 Available on: PC (Steam), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

Add it to your Steam Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4447890/Soccer_Kid_Collection_QUByte_Classics/?utm_source=youtube

ABOUT QUBYTE INTERACTIVE
QUByte Interactive is Latin America's largest publisher of independent games for modern consoles. We are dedicated to preserving retro history and empowering talented indie developers across the globe.
